changes: p1: 'sumati' is not a title but part of the regnal name (Sumatijaya- prefix of the Bhaktapur kings); name normalized to the standard Jitāmitramalla, titles emptied; roles commissioner + king kept (dayakā = caused to be made; not 'donor' as in the catalogue)
p2: Bhāgirāma's role changed from 'other' to 'minister'; title 'paramāna' given as pramāṇa (chief minister); 'yāvelasa' = 'at the time when (he was pramāṇa)'. He is not the scribe (catalogue's guess)
relation p2→p1 changed from under_reign_of to servant_of (minister of the king)
date: ce_approx corrected to 1689 (Kārttika śukla of NS 810 falls in Oct/Nov 1689); paksa normalized to śukla

notes: Newari colophon: 'Sumatijayajitāmitramalla had this book made, at the time when Bhāgirāma was pramāṇa (paramāna = chief minister)'. 'Sumati-jaya-' is the regnal prefix of Jitāmitra Malla of Bhaktapur (r. c. NS 793–816), so it is treated as part of the name and not as a title. The colophon names no scribe; the catalogue's 'Scribe: Bhāgirāma ?' is a misreading, and its 'Donor' field should read commissioner. Bhaktapur as residence comes from the known identity of the king and is not stated in the colophon. NS 810 Kārttika śukla 9 ≈ October/November 1689 CE.
